sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、扎伊尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, the number of measles cases in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，美国麻疹病例数

sentences.en: has now risen to nearly 700, the highest annual number since the disease was declared eliminated in this country in 2000.
sentences.zh: 已升至近700例，这是自2000年该国宣布消除麻疹以来的最高年度数字。

sentences.en: Many of those cases can be traced to two Orthodox Jewish communities in New York.
sentences.zh: 其中许多病例可以追溯到纽约的两个正统犹太教社区。

sentences.en: It's Friday, April 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月26日，星期五。

sentences.en: I'm in the heart of New York City's religious Jewish enclave, Williamsburg, Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 我身处纽约市宗教犹太人聚居区——布鲁克林的威廉斯堡。

sentences.en: Around me are men with black hats, the side locks, the traditional peyote religious garments.
sentences.zh: 我周围是戴着黑帽、留着鬓角、穿着传统佩奥特宗教服饰的男人们。

sentences.en: And about a block away, there's yeshivas, religious schools, synagogues.
sentences.zh: 大约一个街区外，有犹太经学院、宗教学校和犹太会堂。

sentences.en: School buses keep passing with Hebrew lettering on the side.
sentences.zh: 校车不断经过，侧面印着希伯来语字母。

sentences.en: Hi, Bobby.
sentences.zh: 你好，鲍比。

sentences.en: My name is Sarah.
sentences.zh: 我叫莎拉。

sentences.en: I'm a reporter for the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的记者。

sentences.en: My colleague, Jonathan.
sentences.zh: 这是我的同事，乔纳森。

sentences.en: We are here doing a story on measles.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里做一个关于麻疹的报道。

sentences.en: What else?
sentences.zh: 还有什么？

sentences.en: Everyone's talking about it.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在谈论它。

sentences.en: So what's your opinion?
sentences.zh: 那么你的看法是什么？

sentences.en: You've got kids.
sentences.zh: 你有孩子。

sentences.en: Do you back to me?
sentences.zh: 你支持我吗？

sentences.en: I definitely do.
sentences.zh: 我绝对支持。

sentences.en: And I feel like besides for the safety of my children, it's for the safety of the ones with compromised health.
sentences.zh: 我觉得除了为了我孩子的安全，也是为了那些健康状况较弱的人的安全。

sentences.en: The anti-vaccine community is very loud.
sentences.zh: 反疫苗群体声音很大。

sentences.en: They're trying to be very loud.
sentences.zh: 他们试图发出很大的声音。

sentences.en: They're trying to have a very strong voice.
sentences.zh: 他们试图拥有非常强有力的发言权。

sentences.en: And it's okay.
sentences.zh: 这没关系。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Everybody can do whatever they want.
sentences.zh: 每个人都可以做他们想做的事。

sentences.en: But don't put us into a bad light.
sentences.zh: 但不要把我们置于负面的境地。

sentences.en: Don't represent the entire community.
sentences.zh: 不要代表整个社区。

sentences.en: And by community, do you mean the Hassan Jews?
sentences.zh: 你说的社区是指哈西德派犹太人吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, I went to
sentences.zh: 你知道，我去了

sentences.en: Rockland.
sentences.zh: 罗克兰。

sentences.en: I had a very interesting conversation.
sentences.zh: 我进行了一次非常有趣的谈话。

sentences.en: A woman said, a non-Jewish woman, she said, I don't want to do this, but I will cross the other side of the street when I'm with my baby and I see a person in the...
sentences.zh: 一位非犹太裔女性说，我不想这样做，但当我带着孩子看到一个……的人时，我会走到马路对面。

sentences.en: So isn't this embarrassing for us?
sentences.zh: 所以这对我们来说不是很尴尬吗？

sentences.en: My sister was on the train today and there were a bunch of school kids that said, let's not sit next to the Jews because they don't vaccinate.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐今天在火车上，有一群学生说，我们别坐在犹太人旁边，因为他们不接种疫苗。

sentences.en: She was so disturbed.
sentences.zh: 她感到非常不安。

sentences.en: She was extremely disturbed.
sentences.zh: 她感到极度不安。

sentences.en: She felt very hurt by her fellow community members that made her look bad in the eyes of others.
sentences.zh: 她对自己社区成员让她在别人眼中显得很糟糕感到非常受伤。

sentences.en: It was very sad, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这非常令人难过。

sentences.en: Sarah Maslin-Neer writes about New York for The Times.
sentences.zh: 莎拉·马斯林-尼尔为《时报》撰写关于纽约的报道。

sentences.en: Sarah, where did all of this start?
sentences.zh: 莎拉，这一切是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: How did measles get to Williamsburg?
sentences.zh: 麻疹是怎么传到威廉斯堡的？

sentences.en: This epidemic started more than 5,000 miles away from New York City in Israel.
sentences.zh: 这场疫情始于距离纽约市5000多英里外的以色列。

sentences.en: So Israeli Jews tend to go for the high holidays to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 以色列犹太人倾向于在犹太教重大节日期间前往乌克兰。

sentences.en: And Ukraine is in the middle of a serious measles outbreak.
sentences.zh: 而乌克兰正处于严重的麻疹疫情之中。

sentences.en: So some unvaccinated people went to Ukraine, picked up measles there, brought it back to Israel.
sentences.zh: 所以一些未接种疫苗的人去了乌克兰，在那里感染了麻疹，并把它带回了以色列。

sentences.en: Now you have Brooklyn Jews traveling overseas to visit family and friends to Israel, where everyone goes for holidays to see grandma and grandpa.
sentences.zh: 现在布鲁克林的犹太人去以色列探亲访友，每个人都会在节日期间去那里看望祖父母。

sentences.en: And those children, mostly, took ill over there, brought it back.
sentences.zh: 那些孩子大多在那里染病，然后带了回来。

sentences.en: Health officials in New Jersey are warning people who were at Newark Liberty Airport last Friday that they may have been exposed to measles.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州的卫生官员警告上周五在纽瓦克自由机场的人，他们可能接触过麻疹。

sentences.en: Also warning about measles cases in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 同时也对布鲁克林的麻疹病例发出警告。

sentences.en: Officials confirmed a fourth case this morning.
sentences.zh: 官员们今天早上确认了第四例病例。

sentences.en: The number of children contracting the disease continues to grow.
sentences.zh: 感染该疾病的儿童人数持续增长。

sentences.en: Just in the last week, health officials have confirmed 90 new cases.
sentences.zh: 仅在过去一周，卫生官员就确认了90例新病例。

sentences.en: CDC says there are about 107 reported cases so far.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心表示，到目前为止大约有107例报告病例。

sentences.en: We're up to 155 cases that we've confirmed as of early this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 截至今天下午早些时候，我们确认的病例已达155例。

sentences.en: And the thing to know about measles is it's insanely contagious.
sentences.zh: 关于麻疹，需要知道的是它具有极强的传染性。

sentences.en: In fact, measles is so contagious that if one person has it, up to 90 percent of people close to that person who are not immune will get measles.
sentences.zh: 事实上，麻疹传染性极强，如果一个人患病，与该人密切接触且没有免疫力的人中，高达90%会感染麻疹。

sentences.en: Now, measles symptoms are usually mild at first, a runny nose, cough, watery eyes, and low fever.
sentences.zh: 麻疹症状起初通常较轻，表现为流鼻涕、咳嗽、眼睛流泪和低烧。

sentences.en: Then the fever worsens and a rash starts on the face and spreads.
sentences.zh: 然后发烧加重，面部开始出现皮疹并扩散。

sentences.en: Most people can recover fully, but it can lead to pneumonia, even brain damage.
sentences.zh: 大多数人可以完全康复，但它可能导致肺炎，甚至脑损伤。

sentences.en: Which is why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么美国

sentences.en: has worked for decades to get this under control and actually won the battle.
sentences.zh: 几十年来一直致力于控制它，并实际上赢得了这场战斗。

sentences.en: In 2000, the United States declared measles eradicated from the country.
sentences.zh: 2000年，美国宣布麻疹在该国被根除。

sentences.en: Well, given that, why was there a measles outbreak in Williamsburg versus just a couple people coming back from Israel?
sentences.zh: 那么，鉴于此，为什么威廉斯堡会爆发麻疹，而不仅仅是几个从以色列回来的人？

sentences.en: So to understand why this spread like wildfire in this particular community, you have to understand the unique nature of the Hasidic Jewish community in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 要理解为什么它在这个特定社区像野火一样蔓延，你必须了解布鲁克林哈西德派犹太社区的独特本质。

sentences.en: It's a very communal religion.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常强调社区的宗教。

sentences.en: To pray as a Jew, you need a minimum of 10 people to get together.
sentences.zh: 作为犹太人祈祷，你需要至少10个人聚在一起。

sentences.en: So at baseline, it really centers around community.
sentences.zh: 所以从根本上讲，它确实围绕着社区。

sentences.en: Families have a large number of kids, I think on average, six compared to the national average of about two, and sometimes many more.
sentences.zh: 家庭有很多孩子，我想平均是六个，而全国平均水平大约是两个，有时甚至更多。

sentences.en: People babysit each other's kids.
sentences.zh: 人们互相帮忙照看孩子。

sentences.en: They spend a tremendous amount of time together.
sentences.zh: 他们在一起花费大量时间。

sentences.en: And within this already combustible situation, a number of parents just don't vaccinate their children.
sentences.zh: 在这种本已易燃的情况下，一些父母就是不给孩子接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: Since the invention of vaccines, there has always been resistance to them.
sentences.zh: 自疫苗发明以来，一直存在对它们的抵制。

sentences.en: People just didn't understand them initially.
sentences.zh: 人们最初只是不了解它们。

sentences.en: And you kind of get it, right?
sentences.zh: 你多少能理解，对吧？

sentences.en: They're administered to a little baby.
sentences.zh: 它们是给小婴儿接种的。

sentences.en: They require a needle.
sentences.zh: 它们需要针头。

sentences.en: Vaccines contain a version of the germ that they're trying to prevent.
sentences.zh: 疫苗含有它们试图预防的病菌的变体。

sentences.en: But I think you can trace the modern route of this anti-vax movement to about the 70s.
sentences.zh: 但我认为你可以把这种反疫苗运动的现代根源追溯到70年代左右。

sentences.en: One schoolgirl in three misses the vaccination, sometimes because of absenteeism, sometimes because parents object.
sentences.zh: 每三个女学生中就有一个错过疫苗接种，有时是因为缺勤，有时是因为父母反对。

sentences.en: That's when a study came out linking actually the whooping cough vaccine.
sentences.zh: 那时一项研究出炉，实际上将百日咳疫苗联系起来。

sentences.en: We're not talking about measles here, whooping cough to serious childhood side effects like seizures.
sentences.zh: 我们这里说的不是麻疹，而是百日咳与严重的儿童副作用，如癫痫发作。

sentences.en: I believe that the risk of damage from the vaccine is now greater than the risk of damage from the disease.
sentences.zh: 我相信疫苗造成损害的风险现在大于疾病造成损害的风险。

sentences.en: And it was eventually debunked, but nevertheless, it sent whooping cough vaccination rates, particularly
sentences.zh: 虽然它最终被揭穿了，但尽管如此，它还是导致了百日咳疫苗接种率，特别是在

sentences.en: in the UK, where that study was plummeting, from about 80 percent to 30 percent.
sentences.zh: 英国，那项研究导致接种率从约80%暴跌至30%。

sentences.en: I'm happy you've thought about the whooping cough injection.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴你考虑过百日咳注射。

sentences.en: I have, but I've decided I don't want it.
sentences.zh: 我考虑过，但我决定不接种。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: Uh, well, I just think that she could be that one in a million, that something might happen to her.
sentences.zh: 呃，好吧，我只是觉得她可能是那百万分之一，可能会发生什么事。

sentences.en: So I just decided to leave it out.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定放弃接种。

sentences.en: Then a number of documentaries came out, also peddling wrong information.
sentences.zh: 然后出现了一些纪录片，也兜售错误信息。

sentences.en: What we have found are serious questions about the safety and effectiveness of the shot.
sentences.zh: 我们发现的是关于疫苗安全性和有效性的严重质疑。

sentences.en: That really created a resistance among some parents to vaccinate their kids, really particularly in these ultra-liberal enclaves, Berkeley or Washington State.
sentences.zh: 这确实在一些父母中产生了抵制接种疫苗的心理，特别是在这些超自由派聚居区，如伯克利或华盛顿州。

sentences.en: And why there?
sentences.zh: 为什么是那里？

sentences.en: There is already among that group at that time a skepticism of big pharma, of drug companies
sentences.zh: 在那个群体中，当时已经存在对大型制药公司、对药企的怀疑，

sentences.en: pumping things into our environments and bodies that we don't need just to make a profit.
sentences.zh: 怀疑他们为了利润，把我们不需要的东西注入我们的环境和身体中。

sentences.en: Can an employee of a pharmaceutical company that manufactures a vaccine be objective in
sentences.zh: 一家制造疫苗的制药公司的员工，能否客观地

sentences.en: designing experiments to show fault in a product that generates close to a billion dollars in sales for his company?
sentences.zh: 设计实验来证明一种为其公司创造近十亿美元销售额的产品存在缺陷？

sentences.en: These communities pushed for what's called a philosophical exemption that you can send your kid to school without being vaccinated based on a philosophical belief.
sentences.zh: 这些社区推动了所谓的哲学豁免，即你可以基于哲学信仰让孩子在不接种疫苗的情况下上学。

sentences.en: And by the 90s, that spread really across the United States.
sentences.zh: 到了90年代，这确实蔓延到了整个美国。

sentences.en: So now you can send a child to school without having them vaccinated as long as you have this exemption.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你可以让孩子在不接种疫苗的情况下上学，只要你有这种豁免。

sentences.en: What should parents do after a report linking the measles, mumps and rubella vaccines with autism?
sentences.zh: 在有关麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗与自闭症联系的报告发布后，父母应该怎么做？

sentences.en: So then in 1998, this ratchets up exponentially.
sentences.zh: 然后在1998年，这种情况呈指数级上升。

sentences.en: These are viruses that are live.
sentences.zh: 这些是活病毒。

sentences.en: A researcher named Andrew Wakefield publishes a study in a British medical journal called
sentences.zh: 一位名叫安德鲁·韦克菲尔德的研究员在一家英国医学期刊上发表了一项研究，名为

sentences.en: The Lancet.
sentences.zh: 《柳叶刀》。

sentences.en: They are capable of establishing long-term infection and they are capable of producing long-term adverse events.
sentences.zh: 它们有能力建立长期感染，并有能力产生长期的不良反应。

sentences.en: And it claims to find that measles vaccine causes autism in children.
sentences.zh: 它声称发现麻疹疫苗会导致儿童自闭症。

sentences.en: It's a very small study.
sentences.zh: 这是一项非常小的研究。

sentences.en: It just included 12 children.
sentences.zh: 它只包括了12名儿童。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, wildfire.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，它像野火一样蔓延。

sentences.en: So you ask any mother in the autism community, if we'll take the flu, the measles over autism any fricking day of the week.
sentences.zh: 所以你问自闭症社区的任何一位母亲，如果可以，我们宁愿要流感、麻疹，也不要自闭症。

sentences.en: Do you remember Jenny McCarthy?
sentences.zh: 你还记得珍妮·麦卡锡吗？

sentences.en: She was the host of Singled Out.
sentences.zh: 她是《Singled Out》节目的主持人。

sentences.en: I used to love that show.
sentences.zh: 我以前很喜欢那个节目。

sentences.en: I watched it when I was a kid.
sentences.zh: 我小时候看过。

sentences.en: Well, she picks this up.
sentences.zh: 好吧，她接手了这件事。

sentences.en: She has a child with autism and she goes on the anti-vaccination rampage.
sentences.zh: 她有一个患有自闭症的孩子，她开始了反疫苗的狂热行动。

sentences.en: Today, I am a mom of a child who had autism willing to shake the...
sentences.zh: 今天，我是一位患有自闭症孩子的母亲，愿意动摇……

sentences.en: She even publishes a book.
sentences.zh: 她甚至出版了一本书。

sentences.en: Jenny McCarthy is here to tell us about her latest book, Healing and Preventing Autism,
sentences.zh: 珍妮·麦卡锡在这里告诉我们她最新的书，《治愈和预防自闭症》，

sentences.en: A Complete Guide.
sentences.zh: 一本完整的指南。

sentences.en: And she becomes really the poster child mom for the anti-vaccination movement.
sentences.zh: 她真的成为了反疫苗运动的代言人母亲。

sentences.en: So I think they need to wake up and stop hurting our kids.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们需要醒悟，停止伤害我们的孩子。

sentences.en: Meanwhile...
sentences.zh: 与此同时……

sentences.en: Yesterday, a respected British medical journal retracted a study that said the MMR vaccine may trigger autism.
sentences.zh: 昨天，一家受人尊敬的英国医学期刊撤回了一项称MMR疫苗可能引发自闭症的研究。

sentences.en: That study I told you about that set this all off?
sentences.zh: 就是我告诉你的那项引发这一切的研究？

sentences.en: Debunked.
sentences.zh: 被揭穿了。

sentences.en: This publication, which was wrong, was scientifically implausible, which should never have been published to start with.
sentences.zh: 这份错误的出版物在科学上是不可信的，起初就不应该发表。

sentences.en: The researcher, Andrew Wakefield, turns out he'd accepted money from entities that wanted him to reach a certain conclusion, that vaccines were harmful.
sentences.zh: 研究员安德鲁·韦克菲尔德后来被发现接受了希望他得出特定结论的实体的钱，即疫苗是有害的。

sentences.en: The charges were he'd paid children at his son's birthday party to give blood samples and that he'd had a financial interest in discrediting the MMR vaccine.
sentences.zh: 指控称他在儿子的生日派对上付钱给孩子们提供血液样本，并且他在抹黑MMR疫苗方面有经济利益。

sentences.en: And a journalist found he'd fabricated a tremendous amount of data.
sentences.zh: 一位记者发现他伪造了大量数据。

sentences.en: But even the fact that this study gets totally trashed doesn't stop the idea that vaccines cause autism.
sentences.zh: 但即使这项研究被彻底否定，也无法阻止疫苗导致自闭症的观点。

sentences.en: If you happen to be a parent and you say, you know, I'm sorry, God gave me a brain, God gave
sentences.zh: 如果你恰好是一位父母，你说，你知道，对不起，上帝给了我大脑，上帝给了

sentences.en: me personal choice, I'm going to say no to those vaccines because I've done my homework.
sentences.zh: 我个人选择权，我会对那些疫苗说不，因为我已经做过功课了。

sentences.en: It gets picked up by the tea party.
sentences.zh: 这被茶党采纳了。

sentences.en: Where is anybody saying, my gosh, we're living in the days of Galileo?
sentences.zh: 有谁在说，天哪，我们正生活在伽利略的时代吗？

sentences.en: Because it sort of plays into that government don't tell me what to do kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 因为它在某种程度上迎合了那种“政府别告诉我该做什么”的心理。

sentences.en: They take the third round of shots.
sentences.zh: 他们接种了第三轮疫苗。

sentences.zh: 几小时内他们就出现了抽搐。

sentences.en: Alex Jones, the founder of InfoWars, this known conspiracy theorist, gets behind it.
sentences.zh: InfoWars 的创始人、著名的阴谋论者亚历克斯·琼斯（Alex Jones）也支持这种说法。

sentences.en: So jig is up and we're working on getting Jenny McCarthy on.
sentences.zh: 所以骗局被揭穿了，我们正在努力邀请珍妮·麦卡锡（Jenny McCarthy）上节目。

sentences.en: And then it comes from the future leader of the free world himself, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 然后这种说法出自未来的自由世界领导人本人——唐纳德·特朗普之口。

sentences.en: Dr. Carson, Donald Trump has publicly and repeatedly linked vaccines, childhood vaccines, to autism, which, as you know, the medical community adamantly disputes.
sentences.zh: 卡森医生，唐纳德·特朗普曾公开且反复地将疫苗，即儿童疫苗，与自闭症联系起来，而据您所知，医学界对此坚决反对。

sentences.en: You're a pediatric neurosurgeon.
sentences.zh: 您是一位儿科神经外科医生。

sentences.en: Should Mr. Trump stop saying this?
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生应该停止这样说吗？

sentences.en: Well, let me put it this way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我这样说吧。

sentences.en: There have been numerous studies and they have not demonstrated that there's any correlation between vaccinations and autism.
sentences.zh: 已有大量研究表明，疫苗接种与自闭症之间没有任何关联。

sentences.en: In a Republican presidential primary debate in 2015, Donald Trump, who'd been tweeting and speaking about the subject of vaccines and autism for many years, is asked a question.
sentences.zh: 在2015年的一场共和党总统初选辩论中，多年来一直就疫苗和自闭症话题发推文和发表言论的唐纳德·特朗普被问到了一个问题。

sentences.en: Mr. Trump, as president, you would be in charge of the Centers for Disease Control and the National Institutes of Health, both of which say you are wrong.
sentences.zh: 特朗普先生，作为总统，您将负责疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）和国立卫生研究院（NIH），这两家机构都说您错了。

sentences.en: How would you handle this as president?
sentences.zh: 作为总统，您会如何处理这个问题？

sentences.en: Autism has become an epidemic.
sentences.zh: 自闭症已经成为一种流行病。

sentences.en: And his answer.
sentences.zh: 这是他的回答。

sentences.en: I am totally in favor of vaccines, but I want smaller doses over a longer period of time.
sentences.zh: 我完全支持疫苗，但我希望在更长的时间内分次接种较小的剂量。

sentences.en: He seems to link vaccines and autism.
sentences.zh: 他似乎将疫苗与自闭症联系在了一起。

sentences.en: Because you take a baby in and I've seen it and I've seen it.
sentences.zh: 因为你带婴儿去接种，我见过，我亲眼见过。

sentences.en: And I had my children taken care of over a long period of time, over a two or three year period of time, same exact amount.
sentences.zh: 我让我的孩子们在很长一段时间内，在两到三年的时间里，接种了完全相同剂量的疫苗。

sentences.en: But you take this little beautiful baby and you pump.
sentences.zh: 但你带着这个可爱的小婴儿去，然后猛地注射。

sentences.en: I mean, it looks just like it's meant for a horse, not for a child.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看起来那剂量就像是给马准备的，而不是给孩子准备的。

sentences.en: And we've had so many instances, people that worked for me just the other day, two years old, two and a half years old.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到过很多例子，就在前几天，我手下的员工，孩子两岁、两岁半。

sentences.en: The child, a beautiful child went to have the vaccine and came back and a week later got a tremendous fever, got very, very sick.
sentences.zh: 那个孩子，一个漂亮的孩子，去接种了疫苗，回来后一周就发了高烧，病得非常非常重。

sentences.en: Now is autistic.
sentences.zh: 现在患上了自闭症。

sentences.en: And now we have groups that won't let go of this discredited science, actually dedicated to spreading it, almost evangelists for the cause of anti-vaccines.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有一些群体不愿放弃这种被推翻的伪科学，实际上致力于传播它，几乎成了反疫苗事业的传教士。

sentences.en: There's a group called Peach.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫Peach的组织。

sentences.en: It's an anti-vax group.
sentences.zh: 这是一个反疫苗组织。

sentences.en: And in 2017, we start to see a really targeted push by this group and others to bring the
sentences.zh: 2017年，我们开始看到该组织和其他组织进行了一次真正有针对性的推动，试图将

sentences.en: Orthodox community in Williamsburg, in New York, into the anti-vax fold.
sentences.zh: 纽约威廉斯堡的东正教社区拉入反疫苗阵营。

sentences.en: Why target Orthodox Jews?
sentences.zh: 为什么要针对东正教犹太人？

sentences.en: What makes the anti-vax people think that this community is going to be open to their message?
sentences.zh: 反疫苗人士为什么认为这个社区会接受他们的信息？

sentences.en: Anti-vaxers target this community not because they want to get their message specifically out to Hasidic Jews, but because they think they're protecting children and they want to
sentences.zh: 反疫苗者针对这个社区，并不是因为他们想专门向哈西德派犹太人传达信息，而是因为他们认为自己在保护孩子，他们想要

sentences.en: protect everyone's children.
sentences.zh: 保护所有人的孩子。

sentences.en: That's what they think they're doing here.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们认为自己在这里所做的事情。

sentences.en: They flyered their doors with pamphlets that are in Hebrew and Yiddish.
sentences.zh: 他们在门上贴满了希伯来语和意第绪语的传单。

sentences.en: They've set up hotlines and robocalled them to spread this information.
sentences.zh: 他们设立了热线电话，并进行自动语音呼叫来传播这些信息。

sentences.en: These facts are not meant to persuade you in any direction about what we are putting into
sentences.zh: 这些事实并不是为了说服你在我们给孩子接种什么的问题上采取任何立场，

sentences.en: our children, what the purpose of these vaccines were, and why we don't know more about them.
sentences.zh: 这些疫苗的目的是什么，以及为什么我们对它们了解得不够多。

sentences.en: I listened to one of these calls and I was stunned by the misinformation being peddled as fact.
sentences.zh: 我听了其中一个电话，被那些被当作事实兜售的错误信息惊呆了。

sentences.en: This community is particularly vulnerable to this kind of misinformation, really because of how it's structured.
sentences.zh: 这个社区特别容易受到这种错误信息的影响，这实际上是因为它的结构方式。

sentences.en: You're not really permitted to dig into the secular world for outside sources.
sentences.zh: 你实际上不被允许去挖掘世俗世界的外部来源。

sentences.en: That's why it's been so effective for these groups to really use the tools that speak to this community.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这些组织使用针对该社区的工具会如此有效。

sentences.en: Those hotlines, for example, people are already listening to them.
sentences.zh: 例如那些热线电话，人们已经在听了。

sentences.en: So when one robocalls you in your kitchen with all of this false information about vaccines, you're already primed to listen up.
sentences.zh: 所以当有人在你的厨房里通过自动语音电话向你灌输所有关于疫苗的虚假信息时，你已经做好了倾听的准备。

sentences.en: Hello, Dr. Liberty.
sentences.zh: 你好，利伯蒂医生。

sentences.en: Hey, Dale.
sentences.zh: 嘿，戴尔。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Good to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴和你交谈。

sentences.en: Good to talk to you, too.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴和你交谈。

sentences.en: There's no proof that unvaccinated children carry the measles virus and that vaccinated children don't.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明未接种疫苗的儿童携带麻疹病毒，而接种过疫苗的儿童则不携带。

sentences.en: And there's this other thing happening here, which is a cultural trauma that's been handed down through the generations from the Holocaust, where Jews were experimented on.
sentences.zh: 这里还发生了另一件事，那就是一种文化创伤，这种创伤通过大屠杀一代代传了下来，当时犹太人被当作实验对象。

sentences.en: And so it makes sense that there's this skepticism of government and of medical intervention by the government.
sentences.zh: 所以，对政府和政府的医疗干预持怀疑态度是有道理的。

sentences.en: So this is not a religious belief among Hasidic Jews, that they shouldn't get a measles vaccine.
sentences.zh: 所以，哈西德派犹太人不应该接种麻疹疫苗并不是一种宗教信仰。

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，完全不是。

sentences.en: Actually, quite the opposite.
sentences.zh: 事实上，恰恰相反。

sentences.en: And a number of the people I interviewed were really keen to express that.
sentences.zh: 我采访的许多人都非常渴望表达这一点。

sentences.en: There's this phrase from the Torah,
sentences.zh: 《托拉》里有这样一句话，

sentences.en: It means you have to take care of your body in order to do God's work.
sentences.zh: 意思是说你必须照顾好自己的身体，才能完成上帝的工作。

sentences.en: They actually believe you have to keep your health.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上相信你必须保持健康。

sentences.en: But like any community, you're going to have people who do their own thing.
sentences.zh: 但就像任何社区一样，总会有一些人我行我素。

sentences.en: And for whatever reason, a number of them chose not to vaccinate.
sentences.zh: 不管出于什么原因，他们中的一些人选择了不接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And given the insularity of this community, that individual decision became everyone's problem.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这个社区的封闭性，个人的决定成了所有人的问题。

sentences.en: It set off a medical crisis.
sentences.zh: 它引发了一场医疗危机。

sentences.en: Measles is spreading this month throughout the Orthodox Jewish community in Williamsburg.
sentences.zh: 本月，麻疹正在威廉斯堡的东正教犹太社区蔓延。

sentences.en: And by March, in both Rockland, that's a little bit north of New York City, and in Brooklyn, it's reaching hundreds of kids and adults.
sentences.zh: 到了三月，在纽约市北部的罗克兰和布鲁克林，麻疹已经波及了数百名儿童和成人。

sentences.en: Now, later today, the city's health department coming together with elected officials and rabbis to hold a meeting right here in this community.
sentences.zh: 今天晚些时候，市卫生部门将与民选官员和拉比们一起，就在这个社区举行会议。

sentences.en: They want to make sure families here and across the city understand the importance of getting vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 他们想确保这里的家庭和全市的家庭都了解接种疫苗的重要性。

sentences.en: And officials do something extreme.
sentences.zh: 官员们采取了极端的措施。

sentences.en: Health officials have asked parents at three schools to keep their kids home if they have not been vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 卫生官员已要求三所学校的家长，如果孩子没有接种疫苗，就让他们待在家里。

sentences.en: If you're unvaccinated, fine.
sentences.zh: 如果你没接种疫苗，没关系。

sentences.en: You do you.
sentences.zh: 那是你的事。

sentences.en: You don't come to school.
sentences.zh: 你别来上学就行。

sentences.en: Then they up it even more.
sentences.zh: 然后他们进一步加码。

sentences.en: Yesterday's executive order called for nearly 6,000 unvaccinated children to be removed from schools.
sentences.zh: 昨天的行政命令要求将近6000名未接种疫苗的儿童从学校中移除。

sentences.en: Children under the age of 18 who are not vaccinated are now banned from going to public places in
sentences.zh: 在纽约州罗克兰县，18岁以下未接种疫苗的儿童现在被禁止进入公共场所。

sentences.en: Rockland County, New York.
sentences.zh: 纽约州罗克兰县的公职人员下令，未接种疫苗的儿童不得进入公共场所。

sentences.en: Public officials in Rockland County make an order that children without vaccination can't go into public places.
sentences.zh: 两周后，我们今天来到威廉斯堡处理一个非常严重的情况。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, we're here in Williamsburg today to deal with a very serious situation.
sentences.zh: 在布鲁克林，纽约市市长比尔·德布拉西奥（Bill de Blasio）。

sentences.en: In Brooklyn, the mayor of New York City, Bill de Blasio.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们宣布进入公共卫生紧急状态，立即生效。

sentences.en: Today, we are declaring a public health emergency effective immediately.
sentences.zh: 这将强制受影响地区的居民接种疫苗。

sentences.en: This will mandate vaccines for people living in the affected area.
sentences.zh: 它规定特定邮政编码区域（即热点地区）的所有人都必须接种疫苗。

sentences.en: It said everyone in certain zip codes, these hotspots, had to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 卫生部门将对仍然未接种疫苗的人开出违规罚单并处以罚款。

sentences.en: Department of Health will issue violations and fines to people who remain unvaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我们不能让这种危险的疾病在纽约市卷土重来。

sentences.en: We cannot allow this dangerous disease to make a comeback here in New York City.
sentences.zh: 我们必须现在就阻止它。

sentences.en: We have to stop it now.
sentences.zh: 政府能否强迫某人在他们不愿意的情况下接种疫苗，特别是在他们选择以宗教为由拒绝的情况下？

sentences.en: Can the government force somebody to get vaccinated when they don't want to be vaccinated, especially on religious grounds, if that's what they choose to say?
sentences.zh: 1905年，最高法院裁定，州政府可以强制要求接种疫苗，并且对于不遵守规定的人可以处以刑事罚款。

sentences.en: So in 1905, the Supreme Court ruled that a state can mandate vaccines and that there can be criminal fines for people who don't comply.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我偶然发现了一位法官引用的一段精彩的话，他驳回了布鲁克林一些不想接种疫苗的人提起的诉讼。

sentences.en: Actually, there's a great quote I came across of a judge throwing out a case by people who didn't want to vaccinate in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 他说，消防员在扑灭房屋火灾前无需获得业主的知情同意。

sentences.en: And he said the following, he said, a fireman need not obtain the informed consent of the owner before extinguishing a house fire.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，疫苗接种可以扑灭传染之火。

sentences.en: Vaccination is known to extinguish the fire of contagion.
sentences.zh: 这就是这里正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And that's what's happening here.
sentences.zh: 你所在的城市认为这和火灾一样危险，它将尽其所能保护市民，不管有些人喜不喜欢。

sentences.en: You have a city that views this as as dangerous as a fire, and it's going to do everything it can to protect its citizens, whether some people like it or not.
sentences.zh: 然而，虽然它可以冲进房子灭火，但它不能强迫任何人接种疫苗。

sentences.en: However, while it can burst into a house to put out a fire, it cannot force anyone to get a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 事后可以罚款，但无法阻止人们做出这些危及他人的复杂个人选择。

sentences.en: It can find them afterwards, but it can't stop people from making these complex individual choices that endanger everybody else.
sentences.zh: 它做不到，但它可以不断地罚款，把他们关在家里，让他们远离公共场所，让他们觉得接种疫苗是非常值得的。

sentences.en: It can't, but it can find them and find them and find them and keep them in their homes and keep them out of public spaces and make it very worth their while to get on board.
sentences.zh: 哈西德社区对政府结束疫情的尝试有何反应？

sentences.en: And what has been the response from the Hasidic community to the government attempts to end the outbreak?
sentences.zh: 有很多恐惧和愤怒。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of fear and a lot of anger.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得受到了攻击。

sentences.en: They feel that they're under attack.
sentences.zh: 这实际上不是哈西德犹太人的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: And it's actually not a Hasidic Jewish problem, right?
sentences.zh: 这是一个恰好发生在这个社区的反疫苗问题。

sentences.en: It's an anti-vax problem that happens to be in this community.
sentences.zh: 全世界和美国各地都有反疫苗者，但他们通常在视觉上无法辨认。

sentences.en: There are anti-vaxxers all over the world and across the United States, but they aren't usually visually identifiable.
sentences.zh: 犹太社区有一个真正的视觉标志。

sentences.en: The Jewish community has a real visual signifier.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，受到这些出现的不同干预措施的针对，正在给他们贴上污名。

sentences.en: So they say that by being targeted by these different interventions that have cropped up, it's creating a stigma about them.
sentences.zh: 这种污名正在助长已经存在的反犹太主义比喻。

sentences.en: That stigma is feeding into anti-Semitic tropes that are already there.
sentences.zh: 我在罗克兰街头采访时听到了一些非常令人不安的事情，关于人们

sentences.en: I heard some very upsetting things as I interviewed people on the streets of Rockland about people
sentences.zh: 看到哈西德派人坐过公交车座位后擦拭座位，关于过马路时看到戴黑帽子的人走过就遮住自己的孩子。

sentences.en: wiping bus seats when they see a Hasidic person has sat there, about crossing the street and covering their baby when a person with a black hat walks by.
sentences.zh: 这些确实让人想起犹太社区过去发生过的不愉快的事情。

sentences.en: Those really call to mind uncomfortable things that have happened in the past for the Jewish community.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，感觉我们都无力阻止个人和

sentences.en: At the end of the day, it feels like we are all kind of powerless to stop individuals and
sentences.zh: 群体不接种疫苗，或者不接种疫苗并走出家门，因为这似乎是不可避免的。

sentences.en: groups from not getting vaccines or from not getting vaccines and stepping out of their house as inevitably it feels like they will.
sentences.zh: 这意味着作为一个社会，我们必须说服这些人，接种疫苗既符合他们的利益，也符合我们的利益。

sentences.en: So that means that as a society, we have to convince these people that it's in both their interest and in ours to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 是的，当我在威廉斯堡时，我遇到了一位哈西德派男子，他非常坚定地反对疫苗。

sentences.en: Yeah, and when I was in Williamsburg, I met a Hasidic man who was pretty staunchly anti-vax.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我有亲戚的孩子患有自闭症。

sentences.en: Actually, I have some relatives who have a child with autism.
sentences.zh: 她说孩子在打针之前还好好的。

sentences.en: And like she says that a child was okay until she gave the shots.
sentences.zh: 自从打了针，他就变得虚弱，总是出现并发症。

sentences.en: Since he gave the shots, he was weak and always had complications.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，他感觉很不舒服。

sentences.en: Since then, he's not feeling well.
sentences.zh: 然后他掏出手机，给我看了他姐夫的照片。

sentences.en: And then he pulled out his phone and he showed me a picture of his brother-in-law.
sentences.zh: 他的嘴唇，如果你看他的嘴唇，整个，就像，长满了水泡，肿胀着。

sentences.en: His lips, if you see his lips, his whole, like, with blisters swallowed.
sentences.zh: 还有他的全身。

sentences.en: And his whole body.
sentences.zh: 那个年轻人浑身长满了脓疱。

sentences.en: And the young man was covered in pustules.
